The '''National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda''' ('''NISR'''; {{langx|fr|'''Institut National de la Statistique du Rwanda'''}}<ref name=NISR2005>{{cite web|url=https://www.statistics.gov.rw/publication/rwanda-demographic-and-health-survey-report-dhs-2005|title=Rwanda Demographic and Health Survey Report (DHS 2005) |publisher=National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda|accessdate=2020-10-30}}</ref>) is a government agency responsible for collecting, analyzing, archiving and disseminating national statistical data, with the objective of aiding the government of [[Rwanda]] in making appropriate, timely, evidence-based national decisions.<ref>{{cite web |title=NISR—National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda |url=http://amis.minagri.gov.rw/stakeholders/nisr-national-institute-statistics-rwanda |accessdate=18 August 2016 |date=18 August 2016 |publisher=[[Rwanda Ministry of Agriculture]] (MINAGRI) |author=MINAGRI |location=Kigali |archive-date=27 August 2016 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160827235940/http://amis.minagri.gov.rw/stakeholders/nisr-national-institute-statistics-rwanda |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Prior to September 2005 it was known as the '''Direction de la Statistique'''.<ref name=NISR2005/>

==Overview==
Among its multiple functions is the task of working with the National Census Commission to process the census data, including the validation, tabulation, dissemination and archiving of the final census data. The last national census was conducted in August 2022.<ref>{{cite web |author=NISR |date=30 August 2022 |title=Fifth Population and Housing Census - 2022 |url=https://beta.statistics.gov.rw/datasource/fifth-population-and-housing-census-2022 |accessdate=7 November 2025 |publisher=National Institute of Statistics of Rwanda (NISR) |location=Kigali}}</ref><ref>{{Cite news |date=7 March 2025 |title=Why Rwanda's 2022 Census was Over 90% Accurate |url=https://www.ktpress.rw/2025/03/why-rwandas-2022-census-was-over-90-accurate/ |work=KT Press}}</ref> The agency also publishes periodic national economic data for Rwanda.<ref>{{cite web
|url=http://www.newtimes.co.rw/section/article/2016-04-13/198904/
|title=22 years on: Rwanda's story of resilience, economic turnaround
|first=Peterson |last=Tumwebaze |accessdate=18 August 2016 |date=13 April 2016 |location=Kigali |newspaper=[[New Times (Rwanda)]]}}</ref>
